newsitem.title: CHINA: Bank of China FRN attracts 17 to syndication.
newsitem.headline: Bank of China FRN attracts 17 to syndication.

text.p: The Bank of China on Monday signed an agreement on a $200 million floating rate note (FRN) offer that attracted 17 banks and securities firms to its underwriting syndicate, the official Xinhua news agency said.
The FRN, which was launched last Wednesday, has a maturity of five years and carries a coupon of 30 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR), the agency said.
It will be listed on the Singapore stock exchange, it said.
The issue was lead managed by Daiwa Securities (HK) Ltd, Bank of China International and Singapore's Overseas Chinese Banking Corp Ltd (OCBC), Xinhua said.
The Bank of China will use the funds to help support China's infrastructure development, and the energy and raw materials industries, a bank official was quoted as saying.
The FRN was well received by the market and investors, the official said.
